name: drkg-query
description: Query the DRKG (Drug Repurposing Knowledge Graph). Use whenever the user asks about drug–gene, drug–disease, gene–disease, or other biomedical entity relationships in a knowledge-graph context, drug repurposing candidates, COVID-19 drug repurposing, or wants to explore neighbours of any biomedical entity (compound, gene, disease, pathway, side effect, etc.) in DRKG.
